title: Hotels in Zhangjiajie city
text: The city sits 35 km from the park but next to Tianmen, ideal if combining Tianmen with the main park. Hotels cost 30-50% less than Wulingyuan with more restaurants and life. Recommended: Kyriad Marvelous (400-700), Mingjia (250-400), GreenTree Inn (150-250) and hostels near Tianmen cable car.

title: Hotels in Wulingyuan (near the park)
text: Wulingyuan is right at the main park entrance - where most visitors stay. Options: 5-star Pullman (800-1,500 yuan), 4-star Crowne Plaza (500-900), Xiangdian International (400-700, popular with Russian groups), local 3-stars (200-400) and hostels (80-150). Book with breakfast.

title: Intercity buses from Zhangjiajie
text: Main station: Zhangjiajie Central Bus Terminal. Buses to Wulingyuan every 15 min (12 yuan, 40 min), Fenghuang hourly (80 yuan, 4-5 h), Changsha every 30 min (130 yuan, 5-6 h), plus Xiangshan twice daily. For Tianmen take taxi or bus 5 to the cable car for 1 yuan.

title: Taxis in Zhangjiajie - how to avoid overpaying
text: Three types: yellow metered taxis (6 yuan flag fall, 1.8/km), Didi app (Chinese interface), and unofficial black cars at park exits. Typical fares: airport to city 30-40 yuan, city to Wulingyuan 100-150 yuan, to Tianmen 80-120 yuan. Always ask for da biao - meter on.

title: Zhangjiajie railway stations
text: Two stations: old Zhangjiajie in the city center for regular trains, and the modern Zhangjiajie West for high-speed (opened 2021). Direct HSR links: Changsha 1.5 h, Wuhan 3.5 h, Chongqing 4 h, Guilin 4.5 h, Guangzhou 5.5 h, Shanghai 7-8 h. Book early via Trip.com or 12306.
